verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for testing agents automatically on every code change, pull request, or custom schedule. It also ships a terminal CLI, sync/async SDK clients, and project-level API keys for non-interactive authentication, so headless and CI automation is first-party. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, detailed evidence of pass/fail gating behavior (e.g., exit codes or failing the build on metric thresholds).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
